links.outcome: Length of stay, readmission, mortality, and discharge destination with versus without AI, pre-post comparison
links.effect: Median LOS 3.1 vs 2.9 days (P=0.028); 7-day readmission 7.1% vs 5.0% (p=0.02); no significant difference in mortality or non-home discharge.
links.quote: Relative to the control group, use of the Adelaide Score in the intervention group resulted in significantly shorter median length of stay (3.1 versus 2.9 days, P = 0.028) and significantly lower seven-day readmission rate (7.1 versus 5.0%, p = 0.02).

unlisted_practices: AI-driven discharge prediction to prioritize patients for a dedicated interprofessional weekend flow team
health economic (cost saving) evaluation of AI implementation

screen.reason: Prospective real-world implementation trial assessing the clinical, operational, and financial impact of integrating a predictive discharge model into hospital workflow via a specialized clinical team.

primary.practice: workflow integration with multidisciplinary discharge team
